title: Feature request: option to combine notifications in 1 email
content:
If a topic gets 5 new replies in quick succession I get 5 separate emails.

I would like to either:

  1. receive 1 email with all 5 notifications. Of course this means there is an additional delay to save up notifications. But if it is an option I don’t mind the waiting time.
  2. Or a general email notifying me I have unspecified unread notifications that haven’t been read in x time.

 

Additionally I get multiple notifications if there is an accepted answer. Which is a separate issue, but related as it adds to the number of emails I receive from ST.

scraped_replies.html:
I don’t think this option works.
I get multiple emails. What counts as a visit?

This also applies to notifications within the web page.
